title: Mixed Event — Let's Enjoy Together! SpoJoy Park — Episode5 It's Two Versus Two!

meta.Event Outline: Kanade's fatigue has been catching up to her as of late. Worried that it might affect her compositions, she decides to put effort into building her stamina alongside Ena. They hear that a new sports facility called SpoJoy Park just opened near the station...

rows.Line: SpoJoy Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Roller skating was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
My feet feel so much lighter after taking those roller skates off...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And I'm tired...
But I had fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm sure we're all tired.
Still, Kanade, you were skating all on your own there towards the end.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Even though you weren't able to stand without clinging to the wall in the beginning. Doesn't that mean you made a huge amount of progress?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I suppose so...
However, I have Hanasato to thank for being such a good teacher.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me?
Hehe... I'm glad I could help!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I think you were able to skate on your own because you gave it your best effort, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's keep going and have fun with our next sporting activity!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, let's choose what to do next.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But we have so much to choose from...
I'm not seeing a clear favorite.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Table tennis, shooting free throws, tennis... Bubble soccer...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Bubble soccer...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I've heard of that before!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You play soccer while wearing these bubble suits that look kinda like big balloons!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Balloons...? I'm having a hard time imagining what that'd be like...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uhh... It's difficult to describe it in words...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Then, wanna go check out that area?
That's probably gonna be the quickest way for us to get a feel of what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Good idea!
Oh, which floor is it on...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Th-Those look like...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. So this is what she meant. Those suits do kind of look like big bubbles...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And it envelops your entire upper body...
But it's transparent, so we should still be able to see okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yes, that's important...
But these just...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seem like something you see people wear on variety shows. It doesn't seem like a real sport at this point, so maybe we should try something else...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ena!
That's not fair to bubble soccer!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I get that it doesn't seem like a real sport, but it's a full-body workout! Other people attack you while you try to maintain your balance!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And unlike rollerblading, we won't have to learn or practice any of the fundamentals.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not being a technical challenge does sound nice...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, but still...
This seems like the opposite of photogenic...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I bet it's gonna be really fun!
I heard that it's also good for you since it's a nice core workout!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What?!
I-Is that true?! Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, fine...
It looks really silly, but I agree that it could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: However, I'm not clear on the rules...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Then, why don't we simplify things by trying some bubble sumo wrestling?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Bubble sumo?
What are the rules for that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's easy! The person who pushes their opponent out of the ring wins!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that is simple.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And easy to understand. I'm okay with that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Great!
Then, let's head over to the bubble sumo corner!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone have their bubble suits on?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. It's amazing how your whole upper body fits inside. I'm having trouble keeping my balance since I can't stick my hands out.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And it's lighter than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We probably look ridiculous right now, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Do we?
I think it's cute how round we are now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(This bubble's bigger than I realized.
If I fall over, I may not be able to get back up...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Can I even move around all that well...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So, now what?
Do we just start doing one-on-one bouts?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, let's try doing some as teams of two! It'll be more fun if we're all battling it out at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree.
So, let's split into teams.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, we have Minori and Kanade on one side versus Ena and myself on the other.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Let's do our best, Ichika.
But within reason, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kanade, let's give it our best shot!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm getting a little nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know how much I'll be able to contribute, so I should at least do what I can to not get in her way...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's go over the rules one more time! If you step outside of the circle, you're out, and the same goes for falling over.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The team of the last person standing will be declared the winner!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Got it. Pretty much the same as normal sumo wrestling.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's simple and easy to understand.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, let's get started!
Ready... Go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hiyaa!
Ichika, prepare yourself!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?! M-Me?!
se_event_sports_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! W-Wah!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...!
You really go flying when you bounce off someone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
O-Okay, I could handle that one...
But I'll be flung out if I'm not careful.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Now I get it.
You can't win by just wrestling like normal.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We would fall in a split second if we get hit from the side.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, we sorta need a real plan.
How about something like this? First, we'll...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Alright, I understand...
I can't say that I like it, but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: H-Hanasato, are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That was close...
Luckily, I managed to stop before I crossed the line.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But please be careful...!
A blow from the front might send you flying.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought the same thing when I saw that just now. I'm not sure I can handle being hit like that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't worry! If they attack, I'll find a way to stop them somehow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, Kanade, when you see your chance, don't hesitate!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: When I see my chance... Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But how am I supposed to know when that moment is? I don't even know if I'll be able to capitalize on it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Y-Yes, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I owe you a lot and don't really want to do anything to harm you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But this is a competition, so I'm not pulling any punches!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Kanade...
This is unfortunately it for you!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?! W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Noooo!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wah! M-Minori, how are you able to move so fast?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She stopped us?!
We won't be able to get to Kanade now...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Kanade!
I'll protect you!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Th...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Hanasato managed to save me, but I'm still not doing her any favors...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Getting to Kanade won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We may want to go after Minori first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, so...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They turned their attention away from me. Now might be my chance...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Going from the front isn't a good idea, but if I go in from the side...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Ena...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Eep!
se_event_sports_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Nice one, Kanade!
That just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ena, are you alright?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're mine, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Wah...!
se_event_sports_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Th...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
They both crossed the line...
That means...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We did it...
We won, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I never expected Kanade to be the one to come after us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Their teamwork was remarkable.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow... We won...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It's all thanks to you, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure I deserve all the credit...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm glad that I could help.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Kanade!
Gimme five!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
L-Like a high five...?
If we do that with these suits on...
se_event_sports_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh no!
K-Kanade bounced off of Minori and...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Uh oh... S-Someone, help...! I can't get up...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh noooo! I'm so sooorry!!
